content: शाश्वत {%a.%} (-ती|{%f.%}) [शश्वद् भवः अण्] .²1 Eternal, perpetual, everlasting; शाश्वतीः समाः <ls>Rām. 1. 2. 15</ls> (= <ls>U. 2. 5</ls>) ‘for eternal years’, ‘ever more’, ‘for all time to come’; श्रेयसे शाश्वतो देवो वराहः परिकल्पताम् <ls>U. 5. 27</ls> (<ab>v. l.</ab>); <ls>R. 14. 14</ls>. .²2 All. .{@-तः@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of Śiva. .²2 Of Vyāsa. .²3 The sun. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of a lexicographer. .{@-तम्@} .²1 Heaven. .²2 Eternity, continuity. .{@-तम्@} {%ind.%} Eternally, perpetually, for ever.
